name: Matthias
title: Judas' Successor
summary: Matthias was chosen to replace Judas Iscariot as the twelfth apostle. He had followed Jesus from John's baptism to the ascension and thus witnessed the resurrection. The choice between him and Joseph Barsabbas was decided by casting lots after prayer.

keyEvents.title: The Need for a Successor
keyEvents.description: Peter explained that someone had to take Judas' place as a witness of the resurrection, in accordance with Scripture.

keyEvents.title: Qualifications
keyEvents.description: The candidate had to have followed Jesus all the way from John's baptism to the ascension.

keyEvents.title: Two Candidates
keyEvents.description: The congregation put forward two men: Joseph Barsabbas, who was called Justus, and Matthias.

keyEvents.title: Prayer
keyEvents.description: They prayed: 'Lord, you who know everyone's hearts, show us which of these two you have chosen.'

keyEvents.title: Choosing by lot
keyEvents.description: They cast lots, and the lot fell on Matthias. He was counted among the twelve apostles.
